item.title: Novo Nordisk Wegovy Pill Launch
item.description:
• Summary: Novo Nordisk has launched an oral pill formulation of Wegovy (semaglutide) for obesity, generating $355 million in its first quarter and reaching 1 million patients. The CEO cited a pricing sweet spot for the oral launch, with sales shattering expectations. This milestone marks a significant expansion in the obesity treatment market, offering a convenient alternative to injectable therapies.
  • MoAs: GLP-1 receptor agonist
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, STAT News

item.title: Novo Nordisk Cagrisema Launch Plan
item.description:
• Summary: Despite scrapping the single-chamber device for Cagrisema, Novo Nordisk's CEO insists that the launch plan for this combination of cagrilintide (amylin agonist) and semaglutide (GLP-1 agonist) remains unchanged. The drug is positioned as a next-generation obesity therapy.
  • MoAs: Cagrilintide: long-acting amylin receptor agonist that reduces appetite and food intake. Semaglutide: GLP-1 receptor agonist that enhances insulin secretion, delays gastric emptying, and promotes satiety.
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech
